title: Cohort-Aware Descriptive Analysis of Directionality and Heterogeneity of Nucleus Pulposus Transcriptional Programs across Public Human Intervertebral Disc Degeneration Datasets
description: Code, configuration, derived result records, and manuscript materials for a cohort-aware descriptive analysis of pre-specified nucleus pulposus transcriptional programs across public human intervertebral disc degeneration datasets. The frozen default analysis reports descriptive effect sizes, intervals, bootstrap stability, and sign alignment only; it does not establish confirmatory, mechanistic, causal, biomarker, or therapeutic conclusions.
